title: The Merry Men
summary: A collection of five short stories by Robert Louis Stevenson. The tales include 'Eilean Aros,' a tale set in the Scottish Hebrides about shipwreck and treasure; 'What the Wreck Had Brought to Ards' exploring superstition and mystery on a remote island; 'Land and Sea in Sandag Bay' focusing on a salvage expedition for a lost Spanish galleon; 'The Gale,' which depicts a violent storm at sea and its aftermath; and 'Markheim,' a psychological story about a murderer's conscience. The stories are steeped in the wild, rugged landscapes of Scotland and Spain, with themes of greed, fate, and the supernatural.
